en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhamamd Bin Amro, from Jameel, from Aban, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>
having been asked about a man who bequeathed with ‘something’ from his wealth. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘something’ in the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is one from six (1/6)’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn ‘Amr from Jamil from Aban who has narrated the following: “Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam,
was asked about the case of a man who made a will about something of his legacy. He (the Imam) said, ‘According to the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it is one-sixth.”’
